title: Boxing Stance Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a young Black girl in boxing attire are displayed in separate pink panels. She wears a white tank top, blue shorts, white socks, and boxing gloves, shown in different fighting stances with motion effects and impact bursts.
prompt: A young Black girl with short hair wearing a white tank top, blue athletic shorts, white socks and black boxing gloves, shown in four different dynamic boxing poses including guard stance, mid-punch, jumping, and powerful strike. Each pose appears in its own bright pink rectangular panel with white starburst impact effects. The panels are arranged horizontally over a layered background with large black stenciled text elements spelling parts of words, all set against a vibrant hot pink backdrop, realistic painting style with strong lighting and clear details
